CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(From_Mood_behaviour__c), "",
IF(HOUR(From_Mood_behaviour__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(From_Mood_behaviour__c)), TEXT(HOUR(From_Mood_behaviour__c)-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(From_Mood_behaviour__c) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(From_Mood_behaviour__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(From_Mood_behaviour__c))) &
IF (HOUR(From_Mood_behaviour__c) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: From Mood/behaviour Formula
